## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`!` set if this is a breaking change)
- [ ] One focused change, branched off `main` and rebased
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see [DCO](CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin))
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, member data, or production configuration included
- [ ] New dependencies discussed in the linked issue and free of known vulnerabilities
- [ ] Accessibility and responsive behaviour preserved (keyboard navigation, alt text, contrast)
- [ ] I have the right to publish any images or text added in this PR
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or setup changed
